item.title: Wing Back (Outside Back)
item.description: You play the left or right outside. The back nearest the wall is inside; the one farthest from the wall is openside. Those labels swap as the puck moves. In the Seven formation, the strong-side back (puck side) is usually on the bottom. Same job either way: hold your side and don’t get beat to the wall. Your partner is the wing forward on your side. For how the backs line up and cycle, see Backs in the 3-3.

item.title: Swing Back (Center Back)
item.description: You play the middle. Mostly defend, but push forward when you see a chance. Your partners are the two wing backs. Support them first; you can also help the forwards and pivot. For where the swing sits in the Seven formation and when to rotate in, see Backs in the 3-3. Offense With the puck Pass to the forwards or pivot. Pass early. After passing to the pivot, stay down until they pass or drive.
